en: The Second Part of the Analysis of the Monks' Rules (Bhikkhuvibhaṅga)
1.13 Section on Origination (Samuṭṭhānavāra) With how many origins among the six origins of offenses do the offenses conditioned by engaging in sexual intercourse originate?
The offenses conditioned by engaging in sexual intercourse originate from one origin among the six origins of offenses.
They originate from both body and mind, not from speech ... [as above] ...
Regarding the offense committed on account of discharging feces, urine, or spittle into water out of disrespect: of the six origins of offenses, by how many origins does it originate?
The offense committed on account of discharging feces, urine, or spittle into water out of disrespect originates, of the six origins of offenses, by one origin.
It originates from both body and mind, not from speech …pe….
The fifth section on origination is finished.
